CspTrustedSite.description: A2A Lab console origin. LightningOut CSP grant so the framed Lightning Out content (how the Tableau Next Embedding SDK renders inline) may load its own resources and data — frame-src/connect-src/img-src/style-src/font-src/media-src. Governs DIFFERENT CSP directives than frame-ancestors (that is the Session Settings "Trusted Domains for Inline Frames" entry, UI-only); an external LO embed needs BOTH. Parallels the built-in Slack trusted site (WS19/M10, D72).
